title: Verify: Blank message clears on typing and valid submit unit tests
summary: Unit tests for clearing the message and still submitting valid text
description: Prove with mocked client that the message clears on typing and a trimmed valid idea is posted.
acceptance_criteria: Valid submit posts the trimmed prompt once and no blank alert remains
technical_constraints: Use the same mocked client and fixture as the first Verify

steps.symbol: it: typing clears the blank message
steps.action: Add test: click Send with empty text so the alert shows, then fireEvent.change the textarea to 'a'; assert screen.queryByRole('alert') is null and the textarea aria-invalid is not 'true'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "typing clears"

steps.symbol: it: valid idea after a blank attempt is sent trimmed
steps.action: Add test with submitContribution mocked to resolve: click Send blank, change textarea to '  hello  ', click Send; await waitFor submitContribution toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) and toHaveBeenCalledWith('hello'); assert no alert with text 'Enter an idea first'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "sent trimmed"
